newsitem.title: GERMANY: LTU flies to Phoenix, Chiang Mai from Nov 4.
newsitem.headline: LTU flies to Phoenix, Chiang Mai from Nov 4.

text.p: German holiday airline LTU International Airways said it will start services to Phoenix, Arizona, and Chiang Mai in Thailand from November 4.
The airline will fly non-stop Mondays from Duesseldorf to Phoenix using a Boeing 767-300ER, a company statement said.
The Phoenix service will be retained next summer, the statement added.
LTU said it will fly Tuesdays with a Boeing 757 to the northern Thai city of Chiang Mai.

Other new winter services are a Friday flight to New York with a McDonnell Douglas MD-11, and flights to Seville, Granada, Thessaloniki in Greece, Catania in Sicily and Gan on the Maldives. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
